fields.PRODUCT NAME: Golden Flora Hand block Cushion Cover
fields.DESCRIPTION: Brighten your living space with the radiant charm of our Golden Flora Hand block Cushion Cover. Featuring a beautifully detailed floral motif in warm golden-yellow tones with subtle red accents, this 16x16 inch cover is framed by a rich blue patterned border. Hand block printed on premium cotton, it perfectly balances tradition and elegance, making it a versatile addition to any room.
